title: [WIP] Update home page version number to match @objectstack/spec
body:
## Plan: Update Homepage Version Display

- [x] Create a utility to import @objectstack/spec version from package.json
- [x] Update homepage-i18n.ts to use the dynamic version instead of hardcoded values
- [x] Verify the version is correctly displayed on both English and Chinese homepages
- [x] Test the build to ensure no errors
- [x] Optimize to use a constant instead of function calls (code review feedback)

## Changes Made

1. Created `/apps/docs/lib/version.ts` - Exports `SPEC_VERSION` constant that reads the version from `@objectstack/spec` package.json once at module initialization
2. Updated `/apps/docs/lib/homepage-i18n.ts`:
   - Imported `SPEC_VERSION` constant
   - Changed English version from hardcoded `v0.3.3 (Draft)` to `SPEC_VERSION` (returns `v0.4.1`)
   - Changed Chinese version from hardcoded `v1.0` to `SPEC_VERSION` (returns `v0.4.1`)
3. Build verified successfully - version `v0.4.1` now appears in the homepage badge

The homepage now automatically displays the correct version from `@objectstack/spec` package (v0.4.1) instead of hardcoded values. The version is computed once at module initialization for optimal performance.
